entries.message: This update improves watch state and season matching, restyles the appearance and login page, and hides Card Art on media detail pages.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add TV season source selection, episode translation, unmatched episode handling, and translated Up Next warmup.
Tweak: Preserve completed Plex watch state across stale resume data and protect unwatch races.
Tweak: Preserve Trakt-only plays during show replacement and fail closed on occupied targets.
Tweak: Split sync, history import, polling, and scheduling work into focused modules with retry and lease safeguards.
Tweak: Improve appearance controls, changelog navigation, Reddit release bundling, and README screenshots.
Tweak: Re-check suspected Plex unwatches against live metadata and keep cached episode state aligned, preventing stale reports from reaching manual watch review.
Tweak: Keep TV season-source choice and watch-impact confirmation beside search controls, with less blank space across phone, tablet, and desktop.
Tweak: Use provider-neutral empty-season messaging when episode lists are unavailable while preserving TV and movie match results.
Tweak: Modern is the only look; the Classic style and its switch are removed.
Tweak: Card Art checkbox added to the Appearance menu (hidden on media detail pages); Background Art checkbox only on the Dashboard and details pages.
Tweak: Appearance menu rows match the media option rows with icons, and Text size sits at the bottom.
Tweak: Buttons use a neutral default state in both themes; hover changes only text and border.
Tweak: Spoiler toggle no longer tints the whole button when checked; only the checkbox shows the state.
Tweak: Settings use two brand surfaces in both themes, aligned with the left menu.
Tweak: Dashboard and settings surfaces aligned with the left menu.
Tweak: Navbar on every page uses the left-menu tone, not only media pages.
Tweak: About card uses the left-menu tone in both themes.
Tweak: Left-menu search is an underline field in light mode, as in dark.
Tweak: Light-mode changelog entries use the white panel tone.
Tweak: Softer outline on the selected settings section.
Tweak: Onboarding and sign-in footer theme toggle shows the Light and Dark words only.
Tweak: Login panel uses the left-menu tone and its fields use the main-background tone.
Tweak: Login heading reads "Please log in"; the long intro text is removed.
Tweak: "Forgot your password?" sits right-aligned under the password field.
Tweak: Sign-in fields no longer show the default focus outline.
Tweak: Show and movie posters now use provider artwork when a saved local image is unavailable.
Tweak: Card Art is no longer offered in the Appearance menu on media detail pages, which have no cards to show it on.
